package probe

import "os/exec"

// exec.Command and exec.CommandContext hand back a fresh command whose Env is
// nil, so a use of either that is no call is refused: the check cannot tell
// what the program it becomes builds, nor whether Env is ever set on it (P3).

func execCommandValue() error {
	ec := exec.Command
	d := ec("sh")
	return d.Run()
}

var execCommandContextValue = exec.CommandContext

func execCommandArgument() {
	run(exec.Command)
}

func run(c any) {
	_ = c
}
